identity.name: The Spine Journal
identity.source_note: Live current guide retrieved via Apify rag-web-browser headless render (WebFetch returned HTTP 403 from ScienceDirect bot-block); full clean current guide text obtained (HTTP 200). Official journal of the North American Spine Society (NASS); distinct from 'Spine' (LWW). URL: https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/the-spine-journal/publish/guide-for-authors

encoding_notes: case_report and case_series OMITTED: article-types section states 'TSJ is not currently seeking case reports, technical reports, or small case series, with rare exceptions.' (Uncontrolled Case Series is listed only as reporting-guideline category #7 under Clinical Studies.)
technical_note OMITTED (conservative): Aims-and-scope lists 'technical notes' but article-types section says 'not currently seeking... technical reports' — contradictory/ambiguous.
Research Letters (abbreviated original research; <=700 words, <=10 references, 1-2 figures/tables, max 6 authors, no abstract) folded into original_research; not separately keyed.

editorial slot conflates Editorials (Board-reserved), Commentaries (~1500 words excl. tables/figures/refs, references limited to 30), and Perspectives; no single word cap, so editorial omitted from word_limits/sections.
line_spacing: guide states '1.5 or double line spacing' — encoded 'double'; 1.5 is also acceptable.
Clinical Studies word range is 1500-4500 words (~6-12 double-spaced pages); schema holds only the max (4500). systematic_review is a sub-category of Clinical Studies so inherits the same range.
Figure DPI is tiered: 300 dpi photographs/halftones, 500 dpi line/halftone combinations, 1000 dpi bitmapped line drawings; schema holds one value so min_dpi=300 (baseline).
journal_abbrev: guide requires LTWA (List of Title Word Abbreviations) journal-name abbreviation; encoded as 'nlm' (abbreviated form) as closest enum.

Reference formatting not strictly required at submission ('any consistent style'); journal Vancouver/ICMJE numbered square-bracket style applied at proof stage. Encoded the journal's stated proof style.
Tables placement: 'next to the relevant text or on a separate page(s) at the end' — both allowed within the manuscript file; encoded in_text. Tables are included IN the anonymized manuscript.

Basic Science Papers require a different structured abstract (background context, purpose, study design, methods, results, conclusions, clinical significance) than Clinical Studies' 8 subheadings; abstract.sections encodes the Clinical Studies (primary type) set.
declarations.order left empty: guide does not prescribe a formatting order. Generative-AI-use disclosure, if any, goes in a new section immediately before the reference list.

declarations.required: funding + conflict_of_interest + author_contributions (CRediT) are unconditional; ethics_approval, patient_consent, trial_registration are required conditionally (human-participant studies / registered clinical trials).

scrub_metadata set false (conservative): guide requires the anonymized manuscript and supplementary files to contain no identifying info, but is silent on scrubbing document/file metadata specifically.
Submission fee applies: $50 for NASS members, $125 for non-members (paid at submission for unsolicited manuscripts).
Highlights encouraged (not required): 3-5 bullet points, max 85 characters each incl. spaces, submitted as a separate file.
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
